questions.content: Which one of the following substances has the highest proton affinity?
questions.explanation: Among the given compounds, the <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: -0.375ex;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="4.877ex" height="1.92ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -683 2155.6 848.6" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="1D441" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D441"></use></g><g data-mml-node="TeXAtom" data-mjx-texclass="ORD" transform="translate(888,0)"><g data-mml-node="msub"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="1D43B" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D43B"></use></g><g data-mml-node="mn" transform="translate(864,-150) scale(0.707)"><use data-c="33" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-33"></use></g></g></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container>  is most basic.
